WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
INSERT INTO dash_purchase_case
  (code, received_at, date_th, seq, car_model, car_dropdown, car_category, plate,
   phone, seller_name, profile, ads, channel, sell_type, online_offline, case_type,
   purchaser, sender, decision, comment, reason,
   group_id, group_name, message_id, raw_text, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT upper(trim(j->>'code')), now(),
       coalesce(j->>'date_th',''), '',
       coalesce(j->>'car_model',''), coalesce(j->>'car_dropdown',''), '',
       coalesce(j->>'plate',''),
       coalesce(j->>'phone',''), coalesce(j->>'seller_name',''), coalesce(j->>'profile',''),
       coalesce(j->>'ads',''), coalesce(j->>'channel',''), coalesce(j->>'sell_type',''),
       coalesce(j->>'online_offline',''), coalesce(j->>'case_type',''),
       coalesce(j->>'purchaser',''), coalesce(j->>'sender',''),
       coalesce(j->>'decision',''), '', '',
       coalesce(j->>'group_id',''), coalesce(j->>'group_name',''),
       coalesce(j->>'message_id',''), coalesce(j->>'raw_text',''),
       now(), now()
FROM d
WHERE nullif(trim(j->>'code'),'') IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET
  car_model      = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.car_model,''),      dash_purchase_case.car_model),
  car_dropdown   = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.car_dropdown,''),   dash_purchase_case.car_dropdown),
  plate          = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.plate,''),          dash_purchase_case.plate),
  phone          = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.phone,''),          dash_purchase_case.phone),
  seller_name    = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.seller_name,''),    dash_purchase_case.seller_name),
  profile        = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.profile,''),        dash_purchase_case.profile),
  ads            = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.ads,''),            dash_purchase_case.ads),
  channel        = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.channel,''),        dash_purchase_case.channel),
  sell_type      = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.sell_type,''),      dash_purchase_case.sell_type),
  online_offline = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.online_offline,''), dash_purchase_case.online_offline),
  case_type      = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.case_type,''),      dash_purchase_case.case_type),
  purchaser      = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.purchaser,''),      dash_purchase_case.purchaser),
  sender         = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.sender,''),         dash_purchase_case.sender),
  decision       = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.decision,''),       dash_purchase_case.decision),
  raw_text       = coalesce(nullif(EXCLUDED.raw_text,''),       dash_purchase_case.raw_text),
  updated_at     = now()
RETURNING id, code, case_type, purchaser, decision;

parameters.query:
-- เติม "คอมเมนท์จัดซื้อ" ต่อท้ายของเดิม คั่นด้วย " / " · ไม่เติมซ้ำถ้ามีข้อความนั้นอยู่แล้ว
-- แทนชุด Get row → Merge Comments → update ทั้งชุด (ทำในคำสั่งเดียว ไม่มีจังหวะแข่งกันเขียน)
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
UPDATE dash_purchase_case t SET
  comment = CASE
    WHEN nullif(trim(d.j->>'comment'),'') IS NULL THEN t.comment
    WHEN coalesce(t.comment,'') = '' THEN trim(d.j->>'comment')
    WHEN position(trim(d.j->>'comment') in t.comment) > 0 THEN t.comment
    ELSE t.comment || ' / ' || trim(d.j->>'comment')
  END,
  purchaser = coalesce(nullif(d.j->>'purchaserNickname',''), t.purchaser),
  updated_at = now()
FROM d
WHERE t.code = upper(trim(d.j->>'code'))
RETURNING t.id, t.code, t.purchaser, t.comment;
